protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No validated human dose. Research/grey-market conventions cite 250–500 mcg SC once or twice daily, often fasted. 5 mg + 2 mL bacteriostatic water gives 2.5 mg/mL. Human evidence belongs to modified analog AOD-9604, not this fragment.
